summary: No security findings. The advice boundary (REQ-025.1) gains one value import, voidedBets from engine/hand. voidedBets is pure: its BetContext parameter is Pick<HandState, 'street' | 'stakes' | 'actions'>, it reads only ActionRecord fields (street, seat, type, amount, added) and stakes.bigBlind, and returns a set of record indices. It has no access to hole cards, the deck, RNG or any module state. The only caller in advice (situationOf) builds its argument from PlayerView.stakes and PlayerView.actions, which the player view already exposes to advice. So the import exposes no hidden information. The name-based allow-list still blocks every other engine/hand value, and the locked SPEC-06 lint probe tests this. The type-import allow-list did not widen. There is no untrusted input. The O(n^2) scan of the record list is limited by the per-street bet cap and the seat count. The forceFold ring-start change and the invariants.ts hoist are logic tidies with no security impact. No new dependencies, secrets, file I/O or randomness.
